Use case: stylized-concept, ONE isolated fantasy notice-board floor prop. Square 1:1 transparent PNG. Reference1 is the EXISTING Gwynthor BOARD and controls the perspective and ambient LIGHTING of its bottom cobblestone floor ONLY; do not draw that background. Reference2 is one of its POSTERS and controls warm old parchment material, dark brown hand-drawn outlines, muted ochre/beige surfaces and simple painted shading ONLY; do not reproduce the poster headline, emblem or flat poster shape. Hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, crisp dark ink contours, simplified readable angular creases with soft restrained shading, matte warm colors, subtle parchment grain. Not photorealistic, not CGI, not glossy, no modern pristine white office paper. Slight three-quarter view from above, as seen on the floor below this board. Warm low lantern illumination from upper left/front, subdued dark warm-gray ambient shadows. Include a SHORT SOFT semitransparent dark brown-black CONTACT SHADOW snugly beneath and slightly behind-right of the paper, to anchor it naturally on dark cobblestones. No long hard cast shadow, glow or detached floating shadow. The floor itself remains fully TRANSPARENT. Entire silhouette and contact shadow fit with at least 12 percent blank transparent margins. Only the specified old crumpled notice-paper object(s), no rubbish bin, no background, no floor/stone patch, no hands, people, coins, food, text, borders or watermark. Tiny broken dark-brown ink line fragments may show on folded paper, but NO legible words or letters.
SUBJECT: ONE compact round crumpled ball made from a SINGLE old beige-ochre parchment notice, an irregular squat roughly spherical wad with many broad triangular folds and one small tucked paper corner on upper right. Clear shape, no separate extra sheet.
